_comment: sha256 is the Git-LFS object id, which for LFS pointers IS the SHA-256 of the file
content. Obtained from the HF paths-info API at pin time, so integrity is verifiable
without a 2.5 GB download; `fetch-truth-pack.sh --with-weights` downloads and re-hashes.
xet_hash is HF's content-defined-chunking dedup hash, recorded as a second witness only.

files.role: talker + text embedding + microdecoder + per-depth heads + speaker encoder

note_on_shards: The plan said 'all weight shards'. There are NO shards: the repo ships exactly two
unsharded safetensors files and no *.index.json. Recorded as CORRECTION C-6 in
FACT_DISPOSITIONS.md; the loader must not expect an index file.
